verdict.rationale: Lambda's filesystem docs describe a first-party S3-compatible adapter for its regional filesystems. Standard S3 tools such as rclone and s5cmd can copy files to and from those filesystems and perform common file operations, which directly meets the S3-compatible-endpoint path of the story. missing for 10: details on endpoint setup, authentication and throughput or efficiency, documented sync with external cloud storage, and independent or hands-on corroboration that transfers work well.
